qualification: Case bindings only; actual test/native evidence belongs in the task receipt. Public application-owned process host and actual LoggerFactory; no Generic Host-specific lifetime claim.

criteria.originalDescription: Two asynchronous operations keep distinct operation attributes through both provider-created and externally supplied scopes.
Event-specific and nested scope precedence matches the core contract; free-form state cannot overwrite automatic identity or Activity trace/span IDs.
With the documented host configuration, Debug events reach the file while the console emits only Warning and above; unwanted formatter work remains skipped.
Disposing the default provider leaves direct core logging and other runtime consumers usable until the application explicitly stops the runtime.
Host shutdown finishes application work, stops the runtime, and observes the actual drain result; repeated stop/disposal follows the core's idempotent lifecycle rules.
